steps.title: Collect cyanobacterial colonies
steps.instruction: During the peak of a cyanobacterial bloom, use a 100 μm mesh to collect colonies from the water and transfer them into three sterile 50 mL Falcon tubes.

steps.title: Sterilize and rinse blender
steps.instruction: Sterilize a conventional blender with 10 % bleach, then rinse thoroughly with 1–2 L of MilliQ water.

steps.title: Blend collected colonies
steps.instruction: Pour the contents of the three 50 mL Falcon tubes into the sterilized blender and blend on high for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare agar mixture in bottle
steps.instruction: Transfer the blended material into a sterile 1 L round‑bottom glass media bottle, add 15 g of agar, and bring the total volume to 1 L with MilliQ water.

steps.title: Autoclave agar mixture
steps.instruction: Steam‑autoclave the bottle at 121 °C for 30 minutes using the Liquid Cycle 2 program.

steps.title: Plate agar and store
steps.instruction: Pour the sterilized agar into sterile petri dishes, allow the plates to set, and store them at 4 °C.
